title: Best of Asia Shorts Film Festival Showcase
desc: Best of Asia Short Film Festival honors outstanding Indian filmmakers worldwide. Established by ShortsTV, it showcases exceptional talent and will be broadcast exclusively on the channel.

title: Made In India - Peekaboo
desc: Peekaboo - In the eerie halls of a haunted convent hostel, Raavi's cheerful spirit is tested when confronted by a strict Sister and trapped in a terrifying game of hide and seek.

title: Made In India - News
desc: After losing his job due to the pandemic, a freelance reporter struggles to find work in mainstream media, taking an unexpected path to support his family.
